_about: THE DAILY FREQUENCY. Every day the game picks one of each from these pools by the date (so everyone sees the same line on the same day), unless 'dated' has an entry for today, which wins. Satire of the industry's habits, never of named people or companies; ACCORD is always the humans hiding behind their machine. Edit this file on the server to add fresh dated lines; no game change needed.
